2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 606(c) of 2022 for the offence registered under sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and 4 of D.P. Act.
3. Earlier, the matter was sent to the Mediation Center on 20.08.2025 but as per the Mediator's report dated 09.10.2025, the same failed.
4. Both learned counsel for the petitioner and the informant submit that one last effort can be taken in the matter.

5. Let the matter come up on 23.01.2026 when both the petitioner as also the lady (opposite party no. 2) shall remain present in the Court.
6.
List this case on 23.01.2026 as a 'TIED UP' matter.
